verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches this story. The iOS SDK's appHangCallback lets developers add diagnostic context, such as the current screen, when a hang is detected. Correlated Events groups events sharing the same user, device or session, which implies user context is attached to events. Before-notify callbacks give per-event hooks, though they are documented only for ignoring errors. Missing for 10: any documentation of breadcrumbs, a general custom tag/metadata API for every event across SDKs, an explicit setUser/user-context API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
